name: Philip Lau
availability_text: Open to roles in software, AI and digitalization
headline: I build AI assistants and automation that save people time on searching and routine work.
intro: I built MIND, an AI assistant used by 331 engineers at the LEGO Group to search their technical documentation. I also built 15+ Power Apps and 50+ Power Automate flows there. Today I am a Research Assistant at Aarhus University, with an MSc in Engineering and a final grade of 12 (A+).
bio: I joined the LEGO Group as an intern in 2022. Then I stayed three more years as a student worker in Mould Engineering. I built apps and automated workflows on the Power Platform and set up how they were tested and released. I also took MIND, an AI search assistant, from prototype towards a product.

Since January 2026 I have been a Research Assistant at Aarhus University. I build AI tools, including one with the company EIVA. I also supervise three MSc projects and teach master's students to build AI business cases.
My degrees are in business development. So I start with the problem and what it costs the business, and then I build the solution myself.
direction: Next, I want to build AI and software full time, and over the years grow into shaping technology strategy.

quick.headline: Technical Business Developer who builds AI assistants and automation for engineering and business teams.
highlights: Built MIND, an AI assistant used by 331 engineers at the LEGO Group to search their technical documentation.
Built 15+ Power Apps and 50+ Power Automate flows as a citizen developer at the LEGO Group.
Built AskEIVA with the company EIVA, an AI assistant that searches technical manuals and past support tickets for customer service.
Research Assistant at Aarhus University. Supervises AI-focused MSc in Engineering projects (currently 3), teaches AI business cases, and has the TraceableAI paper accepted at OSSYM 2026.
MSc in Engineering and BEng from Aarhus University, both with a final grade of 12 (A+).
Rated 4.9 / 5 by students as instructor in Web Technologies.

about.title: About
about.lead: I work where technology meets the business. I start with the problem and what it costs, build the smallest thing that solves it, and stay until people use it.
about.text: Most of my work deals with knowledge that is hard to find, such as manuals, standards, course material and research papers. I turn it into tools that answer questions and show where each answer comes from.
